title: Elon Musk and Open Source Developments
description: Elon Musk has been making headlines with announcements about open sourcing Tesla and SpaceX technologies.

sources.title: Musk says Tesla to ‘open source’ Model S and X, but prior release makes us skeptical

sections.heading: Tesla Open Source News
paragraphs: Elon Musk, the CEO of Tesla, has announced plans to open source the Model S and X, according to Electrek. This move is seen as a significant step towards transparency and collaboration in the electric vehicle industry.
However, Electrek also expresses skepticism, citing a prior release that did not meet expectations.

sections.heading: SpaceX Codebase
paragraphs: The Economic Times reports that Elon Musk plans to make X's entire codebase open source in August. This could potentially accelerate innovation in space technology.

sections.heading: Elon Musk's Announcements
paragraphs: NDTV Profit has provided a roundup of Elon Musk's latest announcements, which include open-sourcing Tesla and Starship flight developments.

faq.a: Open sourcing refers to making the source code of a project available to the public, allowing anyone to view, modify, and distribute the code.

faq.q: Why is Elon Musk open sourcing Tesla and SpaceX technologies?
faq.a: Elon Musk's decision to open source technologies is aimed at promoting transparency, collaboration, and innovation in the fields of electric vehicles and space exploration.
